investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a moderate ML risk score of 0.57, which is below the high-confidence thresholds seen in historical fraud cases. The graph neighborhood shows no multi-hop linked cards and only one shared device, failing to meet the criteria for Typology B (Distributed Device Ring) which requires at least 3 distinct accounts. Historical precedents with similar or higher scores (0.82-0.91) were cleared as benign after customer confirmation, suggesting this is likely a false positive or low-risk anomaly.
